A lot of times, a laboratory is constrained to one fundamental core group. Over in RHINELAB, **compartmentalization** but with **cross-communication** is of the utmost importance, especially when considering the foundational philosophy and the structural architecture laid out by the founder. Therefore, the category of `@LABORATORY` is formed, in which they are to segment and enact the condition for *divide and conquer, as well as self-sustainment* of each individual laboratories and their comfort zone.
